task: W02 superseded source and exact prompt review for blocked root generation records
scope: Bounded independent review of all 33 non-verified records in brand/provenance/root-generation-records.json. Existing W02 actual source/prompt coverage is recorded where it is exact; six records without an exact prior source-view entry were inspected with view_image. This review does not promote any artwork, alter canonical statuses, author prompts, edit images, generate images, or approve publication.

route_authorization.basis: User-authorized root image-tool route recorded in art/root-generation-authorization.json.

method.exact_prompt_and_source_hash_check: sha256sum over each selected prompt_path and raw_outputs[0].path, compared with the corresponding root-generation-records fields
method.unique_declared_reference_hash_check: sha256sum over each unique declared reference_inputs.reference path, compared with its recorded sha256
method.prior_review_coverage_rule: A prior review counts only when its actual source-view method or exact asset entry names the record/source, or explicitly records the exact source in a viewed reference-lineage list. Generation batch receipts alone were not counted as independent visual review.
method.current_export_source_check: jq '.exports[] | .source_path' brand/provenance/root-export-receipts.json compared to every selected blocked raw_outputs[0].path
method.current_export_source_match_result: 0/33 records match a current export source

summary.current_export_source_check_result: 0/33 blocked source paths are direct source_path values in current root-export-receipts.json exports.
summary.decision: Audit complete. The six newly inspected records retain their blocked/rejected boundaries, and the 27 records with exact prior W02 coverage retain those prior findings. No blocked record is promoted or used as a current export source.
